ignorePatterns.__comment__: GitHub throttles link checks from Actions runners (503, then socket hang up), which fails every docs build on whichever github.com links it drops
The AUR drops the checker's connection (socket disconnected before TLS), which fails every docs build that links the installation page
Geofabrik drops the checker's connection (socket hang up), which fails every docs build that links a download page
nav.tum.de times out on its API preview image (ETIMEDOUT, which markdown-link-check does not retry), which fails every docs build that includes the changelog entry embedding it
DigitalOcean drops the checker's connection (socket hang up) on its product pages, which fails every docs build that links the managed Postgres recipe
